summary: Proxy for AWS inventory sync: either add http_proxy, https_proxy, proxy_username and proxy_password to /usr/lib/systemd/system/receptor.service.d/override.conf, or set them in AWX_TASK_ENV under Extra Environment Variables.
questions: How do I use a proxy for AWS inventory sync?
AWS inventory source can't connect through the proxy
Where is the receptor override.conf for proxy variables?
